name: st-zhongtai-ic
description: A team-type investment committee: routes each task to the best-suited Big-V expert (Lugong / Shanxing / Huishou-Zai-Liyong) or all of them for perspective inputs, then the sector-equity research member synthesizes the report. Data self-verified, conclusions self-derived, conflicts arbitrated by common sense with bull-bear views listed side by side.

displayDescription.en: Three Big-V committee members contribute research angles and frameworks, the deep-research member synthesizes the report; data self-verified, conclusions self-derived, conflicts arbitrated by common sense with bull-bear views listed side by side.
displayDescription.zh: 三位大V委员各供思路框架，研深行汇总撰写；数据自核、结论自得，冲突按常识裁决，多空并列

defaultInitPrompt.en: Deep-dive China Shenhua: let the three Big-V members each give their angle, then have the research member synthesize a report.
